item.title: Trimotors Technology Corporation Is Now The Philippine Distributor Of KTM And Husqvarna
item.description: It’s official: Trimotors Technology Corporation (TTC) is the new exclusive distributor of KTM and Husqvarna motorcycles in the Philippines. This new partnership comes on the heels of TTC’s appointment as distributor for Bajaj sport bikes and Chetak electric scooters, reflecting the enhanced collaboration between Bajaj Auto Limited (BAL) and KTM AG.Read More »

item.title: Pirelli Cinturato With Seal Inside Now In The Philippines
item.description: Pirelli Philippines launches the Cinturato Rosso with Seal Inside, expanding its tire line-up available with the proprietary puncture sealing technology. Once exclusive to Pirelli’s top-tier tires, Seal Inside now makes it to the more attainable tire models.Read More »

item.title: The Puma x McLaren Collection Is Here
item.description: Puma and McLaren Racing announced a multi-year global partnership that merges motorsport performance with contemporary style. This collaboration will deliver high-performance team apparel, lifestyle collections, and immersive fan experiences, connecting racing enthusiasts to the heart of McLaren Racing’s legacy.Read More »

item.title: Manila International Auto Show 2026 Is Slated For April 9-12
item.description: Following the successful celebration of its 20th anniversary, Worldbex Services International (WSI), the organizer of the Manila International Auto Show (MIAS), announces the return of MIAS this April 9 to 12, 2026, at the World Trade Center Metro Manila, from 10 AM to 9 PM. Once again, the country’s premier automotive event will take center stage, bringing together leading automotive brands and placing innovation, performance, and mobility in the spotlight.Read More »

item.title: The Lynk & Co 08 EM-P Is Now In The Guinness Book Of World Records
item.description: The Lynk & Co 08 EM-P is now in the Guinness Book of World Records. The premium plug-in hybrid SUV now holds two World Records: longest hybrid driving range and longest pure electric driving range, achieved under zero-refueling and zero-recharging conditions.Read More »

item.title: The 2026 Volvo EX60 Makes You Forget About Range Anxiety
item.description: Volvo Cars launched the EX60—its entry in the largest electric segment globally. Built on a new platform and running newly developed in-house motors, the Swedish carmaker says it delivers on range, charging speed, and performance.Read More »
